#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

string nextToken() {
    int c;
    while ((c = cin.get()) != -1 && isspace(c)) {
    }
    if (c == -1) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("No more tokens");
    }

    string sb;
    while (c != -1 && !isspace(c)) {
        sb += (char)c;
        c = cin.get();
    }
    return sb;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int l = stoi(nextToken());
    string s = nextToken();

    int max = 0;
    int num = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    string wd = "";

    for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
        char ch = s[i];

        if (ch == '(') {
            max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
            wd = "";
            inside = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            if (wd.length() != 0) num++;
            inside = false;
            wd = "";
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inside) {
                if (wd.length() != 0) num++;
            } else {
                max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
            }
            wd = "";
        } else {
            wd += ch;
            if (i == l - 1) max = std::max(max, (int)wd.length());
        }
    }

    cout << max << " " << num << endl;

    return 0;
}
